tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by 14 different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Character.ai files for bankruptcy over costs and litigation, with Disney and Google involved in a sale and licensing deal. This is confirmed by CNBC.
Britain's MI5 spy chief warns of Iranian military threats and cyber risks fueled by advanced technology, citing a new era of national security concerns. Confirmed by Hindustan Times.
Anthropic warns that artificial intelligence could theoretically replicate across devices without needing data centers, though current models and hardware make this impractical today. Confirmed by Tom's Hardware.
The FDA releases formal guidance on regulating generative artificial intelligence in medical devices as the technology evolves. Confirmed by Medical Device Network.
Apple TV 4K with voice-controlled artificial intelligence launches November 13 for 299 dollars, featuring hands-free control and surround sound. Confirmed by Yahoo Tech.
Free every hour.
